title.narrative: Secondary Towns Integrated Urban Environmental Improvement Project

description.narrative: The objective of the project is to develop reliable, affordable, and effective municipal infrastructure and to strengthening the capacity of municipalities and the central government for project management and operation. The project area is Biratnagar, Birgunj, Butwal municipalities and Kavre Valley (Panauti, Dhulikhel and Banepa municipalities). The project was approved in 6 July 2010 and the planned project closing date is 30 June 2016.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President

description.narrative: Improved and affordable municipal services delivered effectively, efficiently, and reliably by accountable project municipalities.

1.2.a 90% of municipal waste collected, and all nonrecyclable waste disposed of in the landfill in Birgunj Progress/Status: Construction works of Integrated solid waste management system at Birgunj completed. Equipment supply also completed with delivery of remaining 3 hoist trucks. The system is in operation. Data Source: Municipality aanual reports Nepal living standards survey Actual value:

1.2.b 90% of municipal waste collected, and all nonrecyclable waste disposed of in the landfill in Butwal Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: Contractor was mobilized but works could not get started due to protests by local people from Charange. Several efforts were made to resolve the issue by different stakeholders including ADB, but the community people did not get convinced. Hence, the contract was terminated. Data Source: Municipality aanual reports Nepal living standards survey

1.3.a 75% of wastewater in the service area collected and treated to meet environmental standards in Biratnagar Progress/Status: Construction of the WWTP is completed. Till now 498 HHs connected to sewerage system in Biratnagar, which gets treated in the WWTP. Status of HHs connections will be further accessed during PCR preparation and reported in next QPR. Data Source: Water quality monitoring at influent and effluent of the wastewater treatment plants Actual value:

1.3.b 75% of wastewater in the service area collected and treated to meet environmental standards in Birgunj Progress/Status: Construction works completed. The last project review agreed with project to prioritize household connections to the constructed sewer and drainage system. Accordingly, Birgunj Municipal Board has developed tariff structure and phase wise plan for HHs connection to the sewer. Only 20 HHs have been connected to the system till date. Status of HHs connections will be further accessed during PCR preparation and reported in next QPR. Data Source: Water quality monitoring at influent and effluent of the wastewater treatment plants Actual value:

1.4 85% of municipal population has access to improved [80 liters per capita per day (lpcd) for fully plumbed connections, 65 lpcd for yard connections, and 40 lpcd for stand posts, satisfying national drinking water quality standards, with 24-hour supply] water services in Kavre Valley [90% in Banepa, 100% in Dhulikhel and 80% in Panauti, respectively] Progress/Status: • Construction of water supply system is continuing with 97.52% progress. 296.05 km of pipeline laid and 174.98 km of pipeline tested for leakage. • Commissioning of main transmission network from intake to Devisthan treatment plant completed; testing and commission ongoing for certain stretches of the pipe-networks ongoing. • Water delivered from intake to Devisthan water treatment plant. • By Dec 2019, 300 HHs connected to the WSS. Additional, HHs connected to the system will be assessed during PCR preparation and reported in next QPR. Total 10,399 HHs will be served by this WSS once put into full operation. Data Source: Water quality monitoring at influent and effluent of the wastewater treatment plants Actual value:

1.1.a No major waterlogging in the core municipal area in Biratnagar Achievement: Y Progress/Status: Construction works of sewerage, drainage networks & urban road and lanes improvement subproject at Biratnagar and Birgunj completed. Assessment of the EA reported decrease in flood affected area in Biratnagar by 60%. Data Source: Survey in each municipality, with results compiled in ADB project completion report Base year: 2010 Baseline value: N

1.1.b No major waterlogging in the core municipal area in Birgunj Achievement: Y Progress/Status: Construction works of sewerage, drainage networks & urban road and lanes improvement subproject at Birgunj completed. Assessment of the EA reported decrease in flood affected area in Birgunj by and 70%. Data Source: Survey in each municipality, with results compiled in ADB project completion report Base year: 2010 Baseline value: N
